Debrief

Thank you. In this study we tested whether the emotional valence of words in a working memory task affect performance on the working memory task. Every participant saw the same words, but in randomized order. Each block contained either words with a positive, negative, or neutral valence. If you have questions about this research, contact stanfordpsych251@gmail.com. Press the button to save your responses and finish.
